effect_description_eng:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your yellow Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 yellow Digimon for a memory cost of 2.
[When Digivolving] If a card with the [Hybrid] trait or [Zoe Orimoto] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, all of your Security Digimon get +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's next turn.
